title: Worn ring round 4
desc: W2d's arm glow forming made plain to see (W2d2); three new orbit-mote builds of W2f; the rise's fist bend from 45 up to 65 (W5a1-4, W5a as before for comparison) and down from 75 (W5b1-3).

takes.name: halo, arm glow you can see
takes.facts: W2d halo kept; bright construct texture builds up the arm fist to shoulder in 10 slices (10-60), glowing edge rides it, pixels fly from the ring; fp arm higher so the sleeve is in view; halo from 60
takes.cam3p: Cam W2d2 halo, arm glow you can see - third person
takes.camfp: Cam W2d2 halo, arm glow you can see - first person

takes.name: orbit, carousel
takes.facts: texture forms 10-70; 8 motes on one flat ring round the fist, spinning and bobbing, appear one by one from 40
takes.cam3p: Cam W2f1 orbit, carousel - third person
takes.camfp: Cam W2f1 orbit, carousel - first person

takes.name: orbit, comet
takes.facts: texture forms 10-70; one bigger mote loops a figure-8 round the ring with a 6-step fading tail from 40
takes.cam3p: Cam W2f2 orbit, comet - third person
takes.camfp: Cam W2f2 orbit, comet - first person

takes.name: orbit, helix
takes.facts: texture forms 10-70; three motes spiral up the arm from the fist with 2-step trails, respawning, from 40

takes.camfp: Cam W2f3 orbit, helix - first person
